extension.summary: Lädt Kodi-Logs zu GitHub oder paste.kodi.tv und Diagnosepakete zu GitHub hoch.
extension.description: Kodi Logfile Uploader mit normalem Log-Upload, Kodi-weitem Debug-Modus und Diagnosepaket mit bereinigten und gefilterten Logs, bevorzugten Add-on-Meldungen sowie vorhandenen HLS-/DASH-Manifesten.
extension.summary: Upload sanitized and filtered Kodi logs to GitHub or paste.kodi.tv and diagnostic packages to GitHub.
extension.description: Kodi logfile uploader with normal log upload, Kodi-wide debug mode, installed add-on selection and diagnostic packages containing sanitized originals when small enough, filtered log excerpts and available HLS/DASH manifests.
